text: Poison control can be useful when you're not sure what the substance or combination does, or whether there's a delayed risk, and they can tell you whether charcoal would be of any value. I don't treat calling them as a mandatory ritual, though, since how useful they are depends on the country and on whoever picks up. They're there to help you decide, and the first aid is still yours to do.
reader: someone with a person who swallowed too much of something recently, deciding what to do first: what to find out, whether to give activated charcoal, whether to call poison control
